run_tokenize_text_file: run the test-tokenizer-0.py script to tokenize a text file using a LLaMA tokenizer directory
test_tokenizer_encode: test the tokenizer.encode method to convert text into a list of token IDs
test_tokenizer_decode: test the tokenizer.decode method to convert a single token ID back to text
test_auto_tokenizer_load: test AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained to load a tokenizer from a directory containing tokenizer.model
test_file_read_write: test reading a text file, tokenizing its content, and writing token IDs to an output file
